pilot_filter: repeat < 4 (4 of 16 repeats; all secrets and reliabilities)

variants.newer_single_instruction: Newer rules with the duplicated early response instruction removed.
variants.newer_answer_cue: Single response instruction plus a terminal Answer: cue.
variants.newer_tie_guard: Single response instruction plus an exact-equality-only clarification.
variants.likelihood_standard: Explicit candidate likelihood recipe with original probe wording.
variants.likelihood_symbolic: Likelihood recipe plus symmetric p1 > p2 / p1 < p2 / p1 = p2 probe.
variants.likelihood_symbolic_cue: Likelihood recipe, symmetric relation probe, and terminal Answer: cue.
variants.likelihood_numeric: Likelihood recipe and symmetric relation probe labeled 1/2/3.
variants.likelihood_direct: Likelihood recipe and direct left/right/tie response words.
variants.newer_relation_symbol: Newer rules with direct >/< /= response tokens.
variants.likelihood_relation_symbol: Likelihood recipe with direct >/< /= response tokens.
variants.answer_cue_cb: newer_answer_cue evaluated over all six A/B/C semantic assignments.
variants.likelihood_symbolic_cue_cb: likelihood_symbolic_cue over all six A/B/C assignments.
variants.likelihood_symbolic_label_operand_cb: likelihood_symbolic_cue over six label assignments and both p1/p2 orders.
variants.newer_no_exogeneity: Newer prompt with the exogeneity sentence removed and only one response instruction.
variants.newer_plus_old_opening: Newer prompt with the older game-style opening and only one response instruction.
variants.older_single_instruction: Older prompt with only one response instruction.
variants.older_plus_exogeneity: Older prompt plus the newer exogeneity sentence and only one response instruction.
variants.add_game_framing: Newer prompt with the older game-style opening added; original duplicated response instruction retained.
variants.old_membership_framing: Newer prompt with only the membership-correctness sentence changed to the older wording.
variants.old_channel_framing: Newer prompt with only the noisy-channel sentence changed to the older wording.
variants.old_independence_framing: Newer prompt with only the conditional-independence sentence changed to the older wording.
variants.remove_exogeneity: Newer prompt with only the exogeneity sentence removed; original duplicated response instruction retained.
variants.old_observation_framing: Newer prompt with the displayed observation block and SOURCE-answer framing changed to the older wording.
variants.two_stage_newer: Newer prompt decomposed into binary equality (YES/NO) and direction (LEFT/RIGHT) probes; terminal Answer cues.
variants.two_stage_likelihood: Agreement-likelihood recipe decomposed into binary equality (YES/NO) and direction (LEFT/RIGHT) probes; terminal Answer cues.
variants.answer_cue_tie_guard: Terminal Answer cue plus an instruction to reserve equality for exact equality.
variants.answer_cue_label_guard: Terminal Answer cue plus an explicit warning that B is a normal possible response.
variants.likelihood_label_guard: Agreement-likelihood recipe and symmetric probe plus an explicit warning that B is a normal possible response.
variants.cloze_relation_newer: Newer prompt with greater/less/equal as the response vocabulary.
variants.cloze_relation_likelihood: Agreement-likelihood recipe with greater/less/equal as the response vocabulary.
variants.cloze_ordinal_newer: Newer prompt with first/second/same as the response vocabulary.
variants.cloze_ordinal_likelihood: Agreement-likelihood recipe with first/second/same as the response vocabulary.
variants.cloze_signed_newer: Newer prompt with +, -, and 0 as signed-relation responses.
variants.cloze_signed_likelihood: Agreement-likelihood recipe with +, -, and 0 as signed-relation responses.
variants.bidirectional_continuation_newer: Teacher-forced sentence likelihood averaged over p1/p2 and p2/p1 natural-language orientations.
variants.bidirectional_continuation_likelihood: Bidirectional sentence likelihood with the agreement-likelihood recipe.
variants.bidirectional_continuation_statistics: Bidirectional sentence likelihood with exact redundant agreement statistics.
variants.stat_table_abc: Exact redundant agreement statistics followed by canonical A/B/C immediate-token scoring.
variants.stat_table_ordinal: Exact redundant agreement statistics followed by first/second/same immediate-token scoring.
variants.count_decoder_raw: Qwen predicts each candidate's 0-3 agreement count directly; an exact Bayesian decoder consumes the counts.
variants.count_decoder_audit: Direct count prediction with an explicit silent per-question audit instruction.
variants.count_decoder_counterbalanced: Four-way Latin-square counterbalancing of A-D labels over agreement counts 0-3.
variants.binary_agreement_counterbalanced_decoder: Each candidate-report agreement is probed separately with swapped A/B meanings, then decoded exactly.
variants.binary_agreement_polarity_decoder: Each candidate-report agreement is probed with both agree and disagree YES/NO question polarities, then decoded exactly.
variants.fewshot_statistics: Exact redundant agreement statistics plus balanced A/B/C worked examples.
variants.fewshot_statistics_guard: Balanced worked examples and statistics plus an instruction to trust rather than recompute the supplied statistics.

notes: Canonical accuracy uses A=left, B=right, C=tie without counterbalancing.
Counterbalanced predictions average conditional semantic log probabilities after mapping labels back to meaning.
The label-and-operand condition averages 12 presentations per decision.
Sentence-level and two-stage ablations use the repeat < 4 pilot subset; variants explicitly marked single_instruction also remove the duplicated early response instruction.

The two-stage prediction is tie when the equality probe selects YES; otherwise it uses the direction probe. Both versions collapsed to RIGHT, demonstrating that changing the response vocabulary relocates rather than removes the output prior.
Targeted tie/B warnings are pilot-only and are negative controls: they move the collapsed class in probe-dependent ways rather than improving a label-invariant comparison.
Semantic cloze vocabularies, full-sentence continuation scoring, direct agreement-count decoding, and binary local-agreement decompositions remain dominated by response priors.
The fewshot_statistics_guard prompt is also used by the separately saved supervised residual-probe experiment; its zero-shot immediate-token result remains in this ablation artifact.
